mapper.select: select fc.id as id, fc.content as content, p.nickname as authorNickName, fc.created_at as createdAt, fc.updated_at as updatedAt, p.id as profileId from free_comment fc join user u on fc.author_id = u.id join profile p on u.profile_id = p.id where fc.board_id = #{boardId} and fc.is_removed = false;
select id, saved_file_name as name, path, size from profile_image_property where profile_id = #{profileId}
mapper.insert: insert into free_comment (board_id, author_id, content, is_removed, created_at, updated_at) values (#{boardId}, #{authorId}, #{content}, #{isRemoved}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt});
mapper.update:
update free_comment
content = #{content},
updated_at = NOW()
where id = #{id};
update free_comment set is_removed = true, updated_at = NOW() where id = #{id};
